interpretation: The exact eight TIFFs are rights-clear and bounded enough for a pixel feasibility audit.
Same-uploader and same-scanner acquisition controls content and scanner differences between the two labels but provides no independent source or scanner replication.
The scans can measure observable scanner-convolved RGB NPS/ACF repeatability; they cannot identify emulsion grain size, process response or a calibrated stock profile.
Infrared alpha must remain separate from RGB and cannot be interpreted as optical transmittance truth.
next_leaf: After the active P8BP run frees memory and disk pressure, acquire exactly the eight files, verify SHA-1/size/decode and freeze independent crop and nuisance controls before NPS analysis.
claim_ceiling: CC0 same-scanner uniform film-scan metadata feasibility only; not pixels, measured NPS, emulsion truth, physical grain-size calibration, stock response, process identity or product promotion
